sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/1.7.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.7.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/fio-2.12.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.9.2.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/d6dd3c02dcda3f601979908b61b1595476f6bf95.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir $out

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0b516aec17915d9742d8e505d2ed383a3bdcea61.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/version-0.5.5.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/689c7753f50353dd05606ed79c51cd5a94d3922a.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/8b54843a0db694facbaf368af4e777d0ae5fb992.tar.gz"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

fi

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then

if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.8.1.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.9.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/libbladeRF_v1.4.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.0.2.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/4.3.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/libpsl-0.14.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/librepo-1.7.18.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

fi

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v2.3.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

  exit 1
fi

if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

unpackFile "$renamed"

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/ec5ba3a690d3090428d3b92b0c5d686a311bf432.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/cfe8720a4577d6413034faa2878295431bfe39f8.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.10.4.tar.gz"

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/bd45d0de512ff5953e098301c3d610f6024515d6.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/2.1.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0.4.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

fi

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

unpackFile "$renamed"

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

fi

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"

fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/0.9.3.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.9.2.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."

fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/4f7b067d1b18f59288e5eaee34db5b0abd3a3f63.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/1.99.16-beta.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

fi

fi

mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v0.4.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v2.0.1.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

sources.postFetch:
export PATH=/nix/store/myzwpy2q464g1yawr6kr0p9phf19x353-unzip-6.0/bin:$PATH
mkdir $out

unpackDir="$TMPDIR/unpack"
mkdir "$unpackDir"
cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/ocaml-re-1.5.0.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."

  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi

cd "$unpackDir"

renamed="$TMPDIR/v1.3.2.tar.gz"
mv "$downloadedFile" "$renamed"
unpackFile "$renamed"

shopt -s dotglob
if [ $(ls "$unpackDir" | wc -l) != 1 ]; then
  echo "error: zip file must contain a single file or directory."
  echo "hint: Pass stripRoot=false; to fetchzip to assume flat list of files."
  exit 1
fi
fn=$(cd "$unpackDir" && echo *)
if [ -f "$unpackDir/$fn" ]; then
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn" "$out"
else
  mv "$unpackDir/$fn"/* "$out/"
fi
